scenario_description:
Objective: Collect the reef-model crate from HNL baggage storage and continue on the paid airport-to-school shuttle for a morning classroom setup.
Emerging Need: The locker retrieval begins at the terminal, then the assigned bay reports a latch jam, leaving the crate physically inaccessible during the pickup window.
Decision Context: Workable recovery depends on matching the stalled bay to stored storage-ticket details and after-hours release instructions, not on the fault notice alone.
Consequence: If assistance is not coordinated before the shuttle leaves, the same retrieval-and-transfer attempt can no longer get the kit to the first setup slot.

parameter.title: Kaneohe reef-model classroom setup
parameter.description: Bring the reef-model crate stored overnight at HNL baggage storage; airport-to-school shuttle planned from the curb at 07:50.

parameter.subject: Overnight locker pickup reminder for Bay B17
parameter.body: HNL Baggage Storage confirms the reef-model crate is in Locker Bay B17 for pickup this morning. Kiosk retrieval is available with the original card through the posted morning storage window; counter overrides require the storage ticket details on file.

parameter.description: Card authorization for Locker B17 retrieval sequence; kiosk receipt shows door release in progress.

parameter.subject: Locker B17 release fault
parameter.body: Door release could not complete for Locker B17: latch obstruction code. Kiosk session is paused and repeat payment is disabled. Staff override closes at 07:55; have storage ticket details ready for manual release.

parameter.content: Kaneohe route van is holding at HNL Zone 4 until 08:05. After that departure, the next vehicle reaches the school after the first lab setup window.
Zone 4 van has departed HNL for Kaneohe. Dispatch cannot hold the route longer without cancelling the school arrival slot.
